sections.heading: Population
paragraphs: The supervised youth wallet serves 18,400 accounts. Age is checked against the verified account-holder record; parent challenge service returns a pass/fail record to the wallet app.
The September exception report lists BF-Y-017 and BF-Y-018 as approved accounts with missing parent challenge receipts. A manual follow-up request is open with customer service.

sections.heading: Safety
paragraphs: No tracking, behavioural monitoring or targeted ads are enabled for youth accounts. Transaction limits and parent dashboards are active. The feature was reviewed by the child-safety committee on 2026-08-12.
